changelog:
- Initial release of GPT Image Edit skill for RunComfy.
- Supports advanced image editing via OpenAI GPT Image 2 `/edit` endpoint.
- Documented best prompts for preservation, multilingual text rewriting, multi-reference (up to 10 images), and typography/layout precision.
- Provides schema, sample prompts, and clear guidance on model strengths and when to use alternatives like Nano Banana Edit or Flux Kontext.
- CLI workflow via RunComfy with support for authentication and multiple output formats.
- Covers limitations and error code references for troubleshooting.
display_name: GPT Image Edit — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2 (the `/edit` endpoint of ChatGPT Images 2.0) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents GPT Image Edit's strengths (preservation language, multilingual in-image text editing, multi-reference up to 10 images, layout / typography precision), the schema, and when to route to Nano Banana Edit / Flux Kontext / GPT Image 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "gpt image edit", "gpt-image-edit", "chatgpt image edit", "edit with gpt image 2", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
